description: Zones de protection liées aux servitudes de la catégorie EL9 (Passage des piétons sur le littoral) dans la Manche is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Class EL9 easements relate to coastal easements designed to ensure pedestrian crossing along the coast and to provide them with free access to the coast. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Map Viewing Service (WMS) of the dataset: Protection areas related to easements of category EL9 (Passage of pedestrians " (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
